subject: mathematics
concept: Counting objects up to 20 and matching a count to a number
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student taps/counts virtual objects one at a time up to 20
exercise.pictorial: Student counts pictured objects and circles the matching number
exercise.abstract: Student writes the number that matches a stated count

misconception_flags: double-counts or skips an object when counting a set

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
